psQuake.app: third-party notices
================================

psQuake.app is distributed under the GNU General Public License, version 2,
as a whole, because it is the QuakeSpasm engine (GPL-2.0-or-later) with
psQuake's own code compiled into it. psQuake's own files are also available
under the MIT licence (psQuake-MIT.txt). The licence texts named below are
in this folder (Contents/Resources/Licenses) unless another place is given.

The complete corresponding source code is the psQuake repository,
https://github.com/ResourceFork/psQuake, at the commit named in SOURCE.txt
in this folder. It holds the vendored engine, QuakeC and compiler sources
listed in third_party/README.md.


Shipped in the app
------------------

psQuake (the process-monster layer, options page and glue)
  Licence: MIT. Text: psQuake-MIT.txt.
  Its process layer (psproc/) is shared with psDoom, also MIT.

QuakeSpasm 0.97.0 (the engine: Contents/MacOS/psQuake)
  https://github.com/sezero/quakespasm, commit e8795a79.
  Copyright id Software, John Fitzgibbons and the QuakeSpasm developers.
  Licence: GPL-2.0-or-later. Text: QuakeSpasm-GPL-2.0.txt.

LibreQuake QuakeC v0.09-beta (game code: Resources/psquake/progs.dat,
compiled from it with psQuake's additions)
  https://github.com/lavenderdotpet/LibreQuake, qcsrc/.
  Derived from id Software's GPL QuakeC 1.01.
  Licence: GPL-2. Text: LibreQuake-QuakeC-GPL-2.0.txt; LibreQuake's own
  licence notes: LibreQuake-LICENCE-INFO.txt.

LibreQuake game data v0.09-beta (Resources/id1: maps, models, textures,
sounds, music)
  Copyright the contributors to the LibreQuake project.
  Licence: BSD-3-Clause for the assets (LibreQuake-data-BSD-3.txt); GPL-2
  for its progs.dat and gfx/pop.lmp. Its own documents are in
  Resources/LibreQuake and Resources/id1/docs.

The psQuake arena (Resources/id1/maps/psqarena.bsp)
  Generated by psQuake's tools (MIT) with textures copied from LibreQuake's
  maps (BSD-3, as above).

SDL 2.0.22 (Contents/Frameworks/SDL2.framework)
  https://www.libsdl.org. Licence: zlib. Text: SDL2-zlib.txt.

libogg 1.3.2, libvorbis and libvorbisfile 1.3.5 (Contents/Frameworks)
  Xiph.Org Foundation. Licence: BSD-3-Clause.
  Texts: libogg-1.3.2-COPYING.txt, libvorbis-1.3.5-COPYING.txt.


Used to build the app, not shipped
----------------------------------

fteqcc (FTE QuakeC compiler), commit 5662b3a2 of
https://github.com/fte-team/fteqw (engine/qclib)
  Compiles the QuakeC into progs.dat; no part of it is in the app.
  Licence: GPL-2. Text: fteqcc-GPL-2.0.txt.

ericw-tools 2.0.0-alpha11 (qbsp, vis, light), commit c243aa34 of
https://github.com/ericwa/ericw-tools
  Compiles the arena map; only its output, psqarena.bsp, is in the app.
  Licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (its COPYING file). Its Embree and TBB
  libraries (Apache-2.0) come from Homebrew at build time and are not
  shipped either.


psQuake follows the psDooM idea by Dennis Chao (Doom as an Interface for
Process Management, LISA 2000).
